description.value: Union Latino's Restaurant is a Colombian restaurant and party venue with locations in Surrey and Vancouver, offering authentic dishes such as bandeja paisa, empanadas, and whole fried tilapia alongside cocktails and a full bar. The venue also hosts regular Latin events including salsa and bachata classes, karaoke nights, and themed parties. A 'Market' section sells frozen Colombian food items (empanadas, plantain dishes) for take-home preparation.
